what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Hong Kong SAR, China, as recorded by IDMC.
In 2025, the latest year with a figure, IDMC recorded 1403 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Hong Kong SAR, China list storms.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Hong Kong SAR, China.

when.text: IDMC records new displacements by disasters year by year, starting in 2016.
The data shows no year-end count of people still displaced.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went inside Hong Kong SAR, China.
New displacements count movements, not people, and are shown on their own chart.
